name: luma
_comment:workspaces: apps/web, not apps/*: apps/android has its own lockfile and is installed on its own, so Capacitor never enters the server image or its npm ci (A7).

scripts._comment:dev:tsc: Both the backend (tsx) and Vite import workspace packages from their dist/, so without this watcher an edit in packages/* is invisible until dev restarts. Watching the whole solution also surfaces type errors live, and new packages are picked up through tsconfig references.

_comment:allowScripts: npm 11+ warns about dependency install scripts nobody approved, and blocks them when strict-allow-scripts is on. esbuild's script only checks its binary. Approve a new one with `npm install-scripts approve <pkg>`, then remove the @version it pins so upgrades stay approved. A native addon such as better-sqlite3 NEEDS its script: if it is blocked, the package installs without its binding and the app crashes at startup, not at build.
